releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.134:
- 100% VIRGIN MENU ARCHITECTURE: Completely removed all preset subtabs (Cognac, Tequila, Whiskey, Domestic, Imported, Buckets). System ships virgin with zero hardcoded sub-tabs or category clutter.
- CLEAN SUB-TAB CONTROLS: Only user-created subtabs are displayed alongside [+ ADD SUB-TAB] and [+ ADD PRODUCT].
- DIRECT PRODUCT DISPLAY: Products grid directly renders actual products for each department and sub-tab without duplicate big category cards or redundant back buttons.
- 100% Quality Standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings verified across all integrity auditors.
